title: Nudges on tickets taken but silent for days
summary: Grillo now shows a system notification on open and once a day naming the member's taken tickets with no answer for N days (default 3); the nudges share the app's one store so pulls of a project folder stay serialised.
friction: CI could not start on any pull request (GitHub billing: no Actions minutes); every merge used the full local gate on Windows by the user's word, so no Mac build or test ran on these four merges
lessons_learned: A main-process feature that needs the store must reuse the store feature's instance (appStore): a second GitHub store gets its own folder queue and races git pulls in the same project folder
